evals.prompt: We're launching our habit-free meal planner on the App Store and Google Play next month. The mockups are in design/mockup (design-system.css, index.html with all the screens). Can you make the store screenshots for both stores?
evals.expected_output: store.html, store.css, store.js and export.sh copied into design/mockup; store.html links the existing design-system.css and copies (not redraws) the needed screens, as functions of platform. A 5–8 frame shot list ordered promise → evidence → explanation with short benefit headlines, agreed before building. Gallery renders iPhone and Play rails; the marketing-text contrast audit is green and headlines are ≤2 lines. export.sh run: apple/iphone-6.9 at 1320×2868, apple/iphone-6.5 at 1284×2778, google/phone at 1080×1920, sizes verified from the size report and a few PNGs opened.

evals.prompt: I need a Play Store feature graphic and the 1024 promo images for our two subscription tiers (Pro Monthly, Pro Yearly). Also write the Play short and full description.
evals.expected_output: Detects the mockup directory first (or stops and points to mobile-mockups if none exists). Adds subs and feature to renderStorePage: ?sub=0/1 export at 1024×1024, ?feature at 1024×500, using design-system roles only (no new hexes), promise kept in the feature graphic's left half with no small text or device screenshots. Listing text follows listing-text.md: Play short description ≤80 chars, full description ≤4000, character counts checked, same voice as the headlines, no price in IAP descriptions.

evals.prompt: Our App Store screenshots look different from the app — someone made them in Canva with different fonts and colors, and the headlines are long feature lists. Can you redo them properly? We have the HTML mockups in mockup/.
evals.expected_output: Rebuilds the set from mockup/design-system.css and the mockup's screens (not from the Canva images), rewriting headlines as short benefits (one idea per frame) with real in-device product copy. Explains the shot order and shows the gallery for review with the contrast audit. Export captures at authoring size × integer scale then resamples to exact store sizes, and the reply mentions verifying sizes against App Store Connect.
